<translate>
<!--T:1-->
'''Evasion techniques''' are utility moves that help you escape, reposition or turn a fight around: blinding flashes, afterimages, teleports, a healing nap, a roar that pushes everyone back, and Majin tricks that turn enemies into candy or wrap them in gum. They activate as soon as you press the slot key and share a short lockout with each other.
</translate>

<translate>
== How evasion techniques work == <!--T:2-->
</translate>
{{Main|Techniques}}
<translate>
<!--T:3-->
* Evasion techniques must be equipped in a technique slot, and need an empty main hand, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]] skill and at least 5% Power Release.
* After using one, '''all''' your evasion techniques share a short lockout: the technique's duration + 3 seconds.
* They gain experience every time you use them. Spend it on '''duration''' (+2.5% per level, up to +50%) and '''cooldown''' upgrades. Sleep Recovery's duration is fixed, so it only has cooldown upgrades.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:14-->
'''Sleep Recovery''', the '''Candy Beam''' and '''Gum Bind''' are Majin techniques: any race can learn them from Majin Buu, but only a Majin can equip them in a technique slot or upgrade them (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Techniques#Learning techniques|Techniques]]). [[Special:MyLanguage/Kid Buu|Kid Buu]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Kuu|Majin Kuu]] also use Sleep Recovery in the story: they take a 7-second nap that heals up to 60% of their max health.

=== Breaking free from Gum Bind === <!--T:31-->

<!--T:32-->
* A player wrapped in gum breaks free by mashing the '''Sneak''' key ({{Key|Shift}}): every press takes 0.25 seconds off the bind.
* The bind also ends if the victim is knocked down or gets more than 24 blocks away from you.
* Against other enemies, a stronger target is bound for 10 seconds × your Battle Power ÷ its Battle Power, but always at least 2 seconds.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/World Bosses|World bosses]] and giant multi-part bosses can't be bound.
* Majin Buu also uses Gum Bind against you in the story, and the Majin Candy attack of the bosses that use it has the same effect as the Candy Beam.
</translate>

<translate>
== Evasion techniques not taught by default == <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
No master offers these in the default lists. Server owners can add [[Special:MyLanguage/Dimensional Warp|Dimensional Warp]] to a master's list, and admins can grant either with {{Command|/dmztech add}}.
</translate>
